### Critical Issues Requiring Attention
1. **SAM.gov API Key Invalid/Expired** — HTTP 401 on all requests; need to update API key in credentials or environment
2. **Gmail App Password Expired** — IMAP authentication failing; need to generate new App Password or re-run OAuth flow
3. **Sam Hunter Crash Loop** — Systemd service restarting every ~10 seconds because port 5002 is held by stale @reboot cron process (PID 1323). **Fix:** Kill PID 1323, disable @reboot cron for sam-hunter, or fix systemd service to handle port conflicts
4. **Odoo High Restart Count (16,032)** — Service restarting frequently; check Odoo logs for root cause
5. **Yahoo Mail Not Configured** — YAHOO_EMAIL/YAHOO_PASSWORD not set in email-agent/.env
6. **AM Drive Report Delivery Failing** — Discord platform not configured for delivery
7. **Dashboard /auth Endpoint Polling** — Receiving 404s every 15 seconds; either add /auth endpoint or fix health check source
